description.en:
Moves a match player to another position of the formation. The player swaps places with whoever occupied that position, both in the team's match roster and in the on-pitch player data.
The story match scripts call it in InitBtl, right after building a fixed squad with CMND_BTL_ADD_MEMBER, to put each player where the scene needs them.
("CHANGR" is the developers' typo for CHANGE; the function has to be called with this spelling.)
Team of the player: 0 = the player's team, 1 = the opponent team.
Player parameter ID, e.g. "para_cp0001". It must be a string (it is hashed with CRC32 to find the player).
Formation position to move the player to, counted from 1 (the engine subtracts 1 internally).

true once the call has run, including when the player was not found (then nothing moves).
null if the match system is not ready or fewer than 3 arguments were given.

examples.case: Arranging a fixed story squad (real usage, from btl0002.nut)
Putting a player of the player's own team on a given position (real usage, from btl0304.nut)
